description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.3.4
更新内容
- 录屏预览更方便：裁剪预览支持播放和暂停，动态效果预览可显示录制状态提示。
- 录屏和截图更流畅：优化 Windows 与 macOS 的采集、画面合成和视频导出，改善截图复制与保存的响应速度。
- 贴图识别更顺手：可将双击或鼠标中键设为显示、隐藏文字识别结果。
- 修复编辑与 AI 配置问题：图片编辑的效果预览正确保留背景；升级后更可靠地恢复旧版 AI 模型选择。
- Windows 集成更完善：可在应用设置中配置打包版的“使用 Snow Shot 编辑”右键菜单；安装目录统一提供第三方许可说明。
What's new
- Better recording previews: play or pause while previewing a trimmed recording, and show recording status in the motion-effects preview.
- Smoother recording and capture: improved capture, compositing, and video export on Windows and macOS, plus more responsive screenshot copying and saving.
- Quicker pinned-image OCR: assign double-click or middle-click to show or hide recognized text.
- Editing and AI fixes: effect previews preserve the image background, and upgrades restore legacy AI model selections more reliably.
- Windows integration: configure the packaged app's “Edit with Snow Shot” context menu in settings; third-party license notices are consolidated in the installation folder.
下载选择 / Choose your download
Full 提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。/ Full includes all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。以当前桌面用户在终端执行：/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user:
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.4_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition full
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.4_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并完成本地签名。首次安装按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，可把下载链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and signs it locally. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in download links or commands.
